  94|- Input expressions are in infix notation.
  95|
  96|- Only integers and floating-point numbers are allowed.
  97|
  98|- Whitespace is ignored.
  99|
 100|# 具体需求
 101|
 102|
 103|## 3.1 领域模型
 104|
 105|共 **2** 个领域实体
 106|
 107|### Expression
 108|
 109|- **描述**: A mathematical expression provided as a string.
 110|
 111|| 属性 | 类型 | 约束 | 描述 |
 112||------|------|------|------|
 113|| raw | `str` | non-empty, valid characters | The input expression string |
 114|
 115|### Result
 116|
 117|- **描述**: The computed result of an expression.
 118|
 119|| 属性 | 类型 | 约束 | 描述 |
 120||------|------|------|------|
 121|| value | `float` | rounded to 2 decimal places | The numeric result |
 122|| error | `Optional[str]` | null if successful | Error message if computation fails |
 123|
 124|## 3.2 功能需求 (FR)
 125|
 126|### FR-01 🔴 Basic Arithmetic Operations
 127|
 128|- **描述**: The calculator must support addition (+), subtraction (-), multiplication (*), and division (/).
 129|
 130|- **优先级**: CRITICAL
 131|
 132|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 133|
 134|**验收标准**:
 135|
 136|- [ ] AC1: 3 + 4 returns 7.00
 137|
 138|- [ ] AC2: 10 - 5 returns 5.00
 139|
 140|- [ ] AC3: 6 * 7 returns 42.00
 141|
 142|- [ ] AC4: 15 / 3 returns 5.00
 143|
 144|### FR-02 🔴 String Expression Input
 145|
 146|- **描述**: The calculator must accept a string mathematical expression (e.g., '3 + 4 * 2') and parse it.
 147|
 148|- **优先级**: CRITICAL
 149|
 150|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 151|
 152|- **依赖**: FR-01
 153|
 154|**验收标准**:
 155|
 156|- [ ] AC1: Input '3 + 4' is accepted and evaluated
 157|
 158|- [ ] AC2: Input 'abc + 5' returns an error
 159|
 160|### FR-03 🟠 Operator Precedence
 161|
 162|- **描述**: The calculator must follow standard operator precedence: multiplication and division before addition and subtraction. Parentheses override precedence.
 163|
 164|- **优先级**: HIGH
 165|
 166|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 167|
 168|- **依赖**: FR-01, FR-02
 169|
 170|**验收标准**:
 171|
 172|- [ ] AC1: '3 + 4 * 2' returns 11.00
 173|
 174|- [ ] AC2: '(3 + 4) * 2' returns 14.00
 175|
 176|### FR-04 🟠 Error Handling
 177|
 178|- **描述**: The calculator must handle division by zero and invalid input with clear error messages.
 179|
 180|- **优先级**: HIGH
 181|
 182|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 183|
 184|- **依赖**: FR-01, FR-02
 185|
 186|**验收标准**:
 187|
 188|- [ ] AC1: '10 / 0' returns an error message like 'Error: Division by zero'
 189|
 190|- [ ] AC2: 'abc + 5' returns an error message like 'Error: Invalid expression'
 191|
 192|### FR-05 🟡 Result Formatting
 193|
 194|- **描述**: The calculator must display results rounded to 2 decimal places.
 195|
 196|- **优先级**: MEDIUM
 197|
 198|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 199|
 200|- **依赖**: FR-01
 201|
 202|**验收标准**:
 203|
 204|- [ ] AC1: '3 + 4' displays '7.00'
 205|
 206|- [ ] AC2: '10 / 3' displays '3.33'
 207|
 208|
 209|## 3.3 非功能需求 (NFR)
 210|
 211|### NFR-01: Code Documentation
 212|
 213|- **类别**: maintainability
 214|
 215|- **描述**: All functions must have complete docstrings describing purpose, parameters, and return values.
 216|
 217|- **目标指标**: 100% of public functions have docstrings
 218|
 219|### NFR-02: Type Hints
 220|
 221|- **类别**: maintainability
 222|
 223|- **描述**: All function signatures must include type hints for parameters and return types.
 224|
 225|- **目标指标**: 100% of functions have type hints
 226|
 227|### NFR-03: Edge Case Handling
 228|
 229|- **类别**: reliability
 230|
 231|- **描述**: The calculator must handle edge cases like empty input, whitespace, and very large numbers gracefully.
 232|
 233|- **目标指标**: No crashes on any valid or invalid input
 234|
 235|### NFR-04: Expression Evaluation Speed
 236|
 237|- **类别**: performance
 238|
 239|- **描述**: Evaluation of typical expressions should complete in under 100ms.
 240|
 241|- **目标指标**: Average evaluation time < 100ms for expressions up to 100 characters
 242|
 243|
 244|## 3.4 安全需求 (NFR-SEC)
 245|
 246|| ID | 类别 | OWASP | 描述 | 目标 |
 247||----|------|-------|------|------|
 248|| NFR-SEC-01 | input_validation | A1: Injection | All input must be validated to prevent code injection or mal | No arbitrary code execution from input. |
 249|
 250|## 3.5 可观测性需求 (NFR-OBS)
 251|
 252|- **NFR-OBS-01** [logging]: Log all evaluation attempts and errors with timestamps. — 目标: All evaluations logged.
 253|
 254|
 255|## 3.6 用例规格 (UC)
 256|
 257|### UC-01: Evaluate Expression
 258|
 259|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 260|
 261|**前置条件**:
 262|
 263|  - User has a valid mathematical expression string.
 264|
 265|**主流程**:
 266|
 267|  1. 1. User inputs expression string.
 268|
 269|  2. 2. System parses the expression.
 270|
 271|  3. 3. System evaluates expression respecting operator precedence and parentheses.
 272|
 273|  4. 4. System formats result to 2 decimal places.
 274|
 275|  5. 5. System displays result.
 276|
 277|**备选流程**:
 278|
 279|  - **当 Division by zero**:
 280|
 281|      - 2a. System detects division by zero.
 282|
 283|      - 3a. System returns error message: 'Error: Division by zero'.
 284|
 285|  - **当 Invalid input**:
 286|
 287|      - 2b. System detects invalid characters or syntax.
 288|
 289|      - 3b. System returns error message: 'Error: Invalid expression'.
 290|
 291|**后置条件**:
 292|
 293|  - Result or error message is displayed to user.
 294|
 295|**业务规则**:
 296|
 297|  - Operator precedence: * and / before + and -.
 298|
 299|  - Parentheses override precedence.
 300|
 301|

 303|
 304|| 风险 | 概率 | 影响 | 缓解措施 | 应急方案 |
 305||------|------|------|---------|---------|
 306|| Incorrect evaluation due to parsing errors | low | high | Implement thorough testing with edge cases. | Use a well-known parsing algorithm like shunting-y |
 307|| Performance issues with long expressions | low | medium | Optimize parsing and evaluation; limit input lengt | Implement iterative parsing instead of recursive. |

  61|

  63|

  65|- Provide accurate arithmetic calculations
  66|- Ensure user-friendly error handling
  67|- Support standard mathematical syntax
  68|
  69|## 2.2 产品功能概述
  70|
  71|系统包含 **5** 个功能需求，按优先级分布:
  72|
  73|| 优先级 | 数量 |
  74||--------|------|
  75|| Critical | 2 |
  76|| High | 2 |
  77|| Medium | 1 |

  81|
  82|| Actor ID | 角色 | 描述 | 目标 |
  83||----------|------|------|------|
  84|| ACT-01 | User | End user who inputs mathematical expressions. | Compute arithmetic expressions correctly |
  85|
  86|## 2.4 约束
  87|
  88|- **technical**: Must be implemented in Python 3.10+.
  89|
  90|- **technical**: Must use standard library only; no external dependencies.
  91|
  92|## 2.5 假设与依赖
  93|
  94|- Input expressions are in infix notation.

  98|- Whitespace is ignored.

 100|# 具体需求
 101|
 102|
 103|## 3.1 领域模型
 104|
 105|共 **2** 个领域实体
 106|
 107|### Expression
 108|
 109|- **描述**: A mathematical expression provided as a string.
 110|
 111|| 属性 | 类型 | 约束 | 描述 |
 112||------|------|------|------|
 113|| raw | `str` | non-empty, valid characters | The input expression string |
 114|
 115|### Result
 116|
 117|- **描述**: The computed result of an expression.
 118|
 119|| 属性 | 类型 | 约束 | 描述 |
 120||------|------|------|------|
 121|| value | `float` | rounded to 2 decimal places | The numeric result |
 122|| error | `Optional[str]` | null if successful | Error message if computation fails |
 123|
 124|## 3.2 功能需求 (FR)
 125|
 126|### FR-01 🔴 Basic Arithmetic Operations
 127|
 128|- **描述**: The calculator must support addition (+), subtraction (-), multiplication (*), and division (/).
 129|
 130|- **优先级**: CRITICAL
 131|
 132|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 133|
 134|**验收标准**:
 135|
 136|- [ ] AC1: 3 + 4 returns 7.00
 137|
 138|- [ ] AC2: 10 - 5 returns 5.00
 139|
 140|- [ ] AC3: 6 * 7 returns 42.00
 141|
 142|- [ ] AC4: 15 / 3 returns 5.00
 143|
 144|### FR-02 🔴 String Expression Input
 145|
 146|- **描述**: The calculator must accept a string mathematical expression (e.g., '3 + 4 * 2') and parse it.
 147|
 148|- **优先级**: CRITICAL
 149|
 150|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 151|
 152|- **依赖**: FR-01
 153|
 154|**验收标准**:
 155|
 156|- [ ] AC1: Input '3 + 4' is accepted and evaluated
 157|
 158|- [ ] AC2: Input 'abc + 5' returns an error
 159|
 160|### FR-03 🟠 Operator Precedence
 161|
 162|- **描述**: The calculator must follow standard operator precedence: multiplication and division before addition and subtraction. Parentheses override precedence.
 163|
 164|- **优先级**: HIGH
 165|
 166|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 167|
 168|- **依赖**: FR-01, FR-02
 169|
 170|**验收标准**:
 171|
 172|- [ ] AC1: '3 + 4 * 2' returns 11.00
 173|
 174|- [ ] AC2: '(3 + 4) * 2' returns 14.00
 175|
 176|### FR-04 🟠 Error Handling
 177|
 178|- **描述**: The calculator must handle division by zero and invalid input with clear error messages.
 179|
 180|- **优先级**: HIGH
 181|
 182|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 183|
 184|- **依赖**: FR-01, FR-02
 185|
 186|**验收标准**:
 187|
 188|- [ ] AC1: '10 / 0' returns an error message like 'Error: Division by zero'
 189|
 190|- [ ] AC2: 'abc + 5' returns an error message like 'Error: Invalid expression'
 191|
 192|### FR-05 🟡 Result Formatting
 193|
 194|- **描述**: The calculator must display results rounded to 2 decimal places.
 195|
 196|- **优先级**: MEDIUM
 197|
 198|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 199|
 200|- **依赖**: FR-01
 201|
 202|**验收标准**:
 203|
 204|- [ ] AC1: '3 + 4' displays '7.00'
 205|
 206|- [ ] AC2: '10 / 3' displays '3.33'
 207|
 208|
 209|## 3.3 非功能需求 (NFR)
 210|
 211|### NFR-01: Code Documentation
 212|
 213|- **类别**: maintainability
 214|
 215|- **描述**: All functions must have complete docstrings describing purpose, parameters, and return values.
 216|
 217|- **目标指标**: 100% of public functions have docstrings
 218|
 219|### NFR-02: Type Hints
 220|
 221|- **类别**: maintainability
 222|
 223|- **描述**: All function signatures must include type hints for parameters and return types.
 224|
 225|- **目标指标**: 100% of functions have type hints
 226|
 227|### NFR-03: Edge Case Handling
 228|
 229|- **类别**: reliability
 230|
 231|- **描述**: The calculator must handle edge cases like empty input, whitespace, and very large numbers gracefully.
 232|
 233|- **目标指标**: No crashes on any valid or invalid input
 234|
 235|### NFR-04: Expression Evaluation Speed
 236|
 237|- **类别**: performance
 238|
 239|- **描述**: Evaluation of typical expressions should complete in under 100ms.
 240|
 241|- **目标指标**: Average evaluation time < 100ms for expressions up to 100 characters
 242|
 243|
 244|## 3.4 安全需求 (NFR-SEC)
 245|
 246|| ID | 类别 | OWASP | 描述 | 目标 |
 247||----|------|-------|------|------|
 248|| NFR-SEC-01 | input_validation | A1: Injection | All input must be validated to prevent code injection or mal | No arbitrary code execution from input. |
 249|
 250|## 3.5 可观测性需求 (NFR-OBS)
 251|
 252|- **NFR-OBS-01** [logging]: Log all evaluation attempts and errors with timestamps. — 目标: All evaluations logged.
 253|
 254|
 255|## 3.6 用例规格 (UC)
 256|
 257|### UC-01: Evaluate Expression
 258|
 259|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 260|
 261|**前置条件**:
 262|
 263|  - User has a valid mathematical expression string.
 264|
 265|**主流程**:
 266|
 267|  1. 1. User inputs expression string.
 268|
 269|  2. 2. System parses the expression.
 270|
 271|  3. 3. System evaluates expression respecting operator precedence and parentheses.
 272|
 273|  4. 4. System formats result to 2 decimal places.
 274|
 275|  5. 5. System displays result.
 276|
 277|**备选流程**:
 278|
 279|  - **当 Division by zero**:
 280|
 281|      - 2a. System detects division by zero.
 282|
 283|      - 3a. System returns error message: 'Error: Division by zero'.
 284|
 285|  - **当 Invalid input**:
 286|
 287|      - 2b. System detects invalid characters or syntax.
 288|
 289|      - 3b. System returns error message: 'Error: Invalid expression'.
 290|
 291|**后置条件**:
 292|
 293|  - Result or error message is displayed to user.
 294|
 295|**业务规则**:
 296|
 297|  - Operator precedence: * and / before + and -.
 298|
 299|  - Parentheses override precedence.
 300|

 306|| Incorrect evaluation due to parsing errors | low | high | Implement thorough testing with edge cases. | Use a well-known parsing algorithm like shunting-y |
 307|| Performance issues with long expressions | low | medium | Optimize parsing and evaluation; limit input lengt | Implement iterative parsing instead of recursive. |

 232|

 236|
 237|- **类别**: performance
 238|

 240|

 255|## 3.6 用例规格 (UC)
 256|
 257|### UC-01: Evaluate Expression
 258|
 259|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 260|
 261|**前置条件**:
 262|
 263|  - User has a valid mathematical expression string.
 264|
 265|**主流程**:
 266|
 267|  1. 1. User inputs expression string.
 268|
 269|  2. 2. System parses the expression.
 270|
 271|  3. 3. System evaluates expression respecting operator precedence and parentheses.
 272|
 273|  4. 4. System formats result to 2 decimal places.
 274|
 275|  5. 5. System displays result.
 276|
 277|**备选流程**:
 278|
 279|  - **当 Division by zero**:
 280|
 281|      - 2a. System detects division by zero.
 282|
 283|      - 3a. System returns error message: 'Error: Division by zero'.
 284|

 286|

 288|
 289|      - 3b. System returns error message: 'Error: Invalid expression'.
 290|
 291|**后置条件**:
 292|
 293|  - Result or error message is displayed to user.
 294|

 296|
 297|  - Operator precedence: * and / before + and -.
 298|
 299|  - Parentheses override precedence.

 141|

 149|

 103|## 3.1 领域模型
 104|
 105|共 **2** 个领域实体
 106|
 107|### Expression
 108|
 109|- **描述**: A mathematical expression provided as a string.
 110|
 111|| 属性 | 类型 | 约束 | 描述 |

 116|
 117|- **描述**: The computed result of an expression.
 118|
 119|| 属性 | 类型 | 约束 | 描述 |

 124|## 3.2 功能需求 (FR)
 125|
 126|### FR-01 🔴 Basic Arithmetic Operations
 127|
 128|- **描述**: The calculator must support addition (+), subtraction (-), multiplication (*), and division (/).
 129|
 130|- **优先级**: CRITICAL
 131|
 132|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 133|
 134|**验收标准**:
 135|
 136|- [ ] AC1: 3 + 4 returns 7.00
 137|
 138|- [ ] AC2: 10 - 5 returns 5.00
 139|
 140|- [ ] AC3: 6 * 7 returns 42.00
 141|
 142|- [ ] AC4: 15 / 3 returns 5.00
 143|
 144|### FR-02 🔴 String Expression Input
 145|
 146|- **描述**: The calculator must accept a string mathematical expression (e.g., '3 + 4 * 2') and parse it.
 147|
 148|- **优先级**: CRITICAL
 149|
 150|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 151|
 152|- **依赖**: FR-01
 153|
 154|**验收标准**:
 155|
 156|- [ ] AC1: Input '3 + 4' is accepted and evaluated
 157|
 158|- [ ] AC2: Input 'abc + 5' returns an error
 159|
 160|### FR-03 🟠 Operator Precedence
 161|
 162|- **描述**: The calculator must follow standard operator precedence: multiplication and division before addition and subtraction. Parentheses override precedence.
 163|
 164|- **优先级**: HIGH
 165|
 166|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 167|
 168|- **依赖**: FR-01, FR-02
 169|
 170|**验收标准**:
 171|
 172|- [ ] AC1: '3 + 4 * 2' returns 11.00
 173|
 174|- [ ] AC2: '(3 + 4) * 2' returns 14.00
 175|
 176|### FR-04 🟠 Error Handling
 177|
 178|- **描述**: The calculator must handle division by zero and invalid input with clear error messages.
 179|
 180|- **优先级**: HIGH
 181|
 182|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 183|
 184|- **依赖**: FR-01, FR-02
 185|
 186|**验收标准**:
 187|
 188|- [ ] AC1: '10 / 0' returns an error message like 'Error: Division by zero'
 189|
 190|- [ ] AC2: 'abc + 5' returns an error message like 'Error: Invalid expression'
 191|
 192|### FR-05 🟡 Result Formatting
 193|
 194|- **描述**: The calculator must display results rounded to 2 decimal places.
 195|
 196|- **优先级**: MEDIUM
 197|
 198|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 199|
 200|- **依赖**: FR-01
 201|
 202|**验收标准**:
 203|
 204|- [ ] AC1: '3 + 4' displays '7.00'
 205|
 206|- [ ] AC2: '10 / 3' displays '3.33'
 207|

 217|- **目标指标**: 100% of public functions have docstrings
 218|
 219|### NFR-02: Type Hints
 220|
 221|- **类别**: maintainability
 222|
 223|- **描述**: All function signatures must include type hints for parameters and return types.
 224|
 225|- **目标指标**: 100% of functions have type hints
 226|
 227|### NFR-03: Edge Case Handling
 228|
 229|- **类别**: reliability
 230|
 231|- **描述**: The calculator must handle edge cases like empty input, whitespace, and very large numbers gracefully.
 232|
 233|- **目标指标**: No crashes on any valid or invalid input

 236|
 237|- **类别**: performance

 239|- **描述**: Evaluation of typical expressions should complete in under 100ms.

 241|- **目标指标**: Average evaluation time < 100ms for expressions up to 100 characters

 255|## 3.6 用例规格 (UC)
 256|
 257|### UC-01: Evaluate Expression
 258|
 259|- **参与者**: ACT-01
 260|
 261|**前置条件**:
 262|
 263|  - User has a valid mathematical expression string.
 264|
 265|**主流程**:
 266|
 267|  1. 1. User inputs expression string.
 268|
 269|  2. 2. System parses the expression.
 270|
 271|  3. 3. System evaluates expression respecting operator precedence and parentheses.
 272|
 273|  4. 4. System formats result to 2 decimal places.
 274|
 275|  5. 5. System displays result.
 276|
 277|**备选流程**:
 278|
 279|  - **当 Division by zero**:
 280|
 281|      - 2a. System detects division by zero.
 282|
 283|      - 3a. System returns error message: 'Error: Division by zero'.
 284|
 285|  - **当 Invalid input**:
 286|
 287|      - 2b. System detects invalid characters or syntax.
 288|
 289|      - 3b. System returns error message: 'Error: Invalid expression'.
 290|
 291|**后置条件**:
 292|
 293|  - Result or error message is displayed to user.
 294|
 295|**业务规则**:
 296|
 297|  - Operator precedence: * and / before + and -.
 298|
 299|  - Parentheses override precedence.
